search.title: Hybrid Analysis API v2: POST /api/v2/search/hash and GET /api/v2/report/{id}/summary (read-only)

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor): the terms page is JS-only (unverified 2026-11-26): legal records whether the team's vetted free key permits corporate use (key_plans.hybridanalysis='business'); otherwise a CrowdStrike licence is required before it runs under the corporate profile.

search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P174 cond 3). Read-only by construction: POST /api/v2/search/hash (form hash=) and GET /api/v2/report/{id}/summary only; no /submit/* or /quick-scan/* endpoint is ever built (a public-sandbox submission publishes and detonates the sample, rule 7). Without a key: 403 {'message': 'API key is missing...'} (research); an invalid key: 403 'Your API key is incompatible with API v2'. 404 or [] = EMPTY. Submitted file names and submission records are never copied (personal-data risk). Provider data is not redistributed (x_redistribution).
search.licensed_alternative: A CrowdStrike licence, or legal's written confirmation that the team's vetted free key permits corporate use (key_plans.hybridanalysis = 'business'); meanwhile the manual page threat_intel_g07_p2:hybrid_analysis_search.
